events.title: Annual Industry Event
events.description:
Hello everyone! 😊
 With our Annual Industry Event just one week away, we’re excited to introduce our speakers. 
 Denise is a Sales Engineer at Texas Instruments with more than five years of experience in the semiconductor industry. A Chemical Engineering graduate of the University of Washington, she now works in a role traditionally associated with electrical engineering. 
 At UW, Denise served as President of SWE and was an active member of WiChE and SHPE. She conducted research in the Nance Lab, the UW Cleanroom in Fluke Hall, and iGEM. During her junior year, she interned at Boeing as a Propulsion Engineer in Everett. 
 At Texas Instruments, Denise has supported customers across data centers, building automation, grid infrastructure, and battery management. Beyond her core role, she leads recruiting efforts through partnerships with USC, SWE, and SHPE; serves as Development Chair for TI’s Women’s Employee Network (WEN); and leads training and professional development for new college graduates. 
 Denise is passionate about the intersection of technical problem-solving, relationship-building, and collaboration, as well as finding ways to make the world better through semiconductor technology. 
 If you have not already, register for our industry event on November 12th using the link in our bio :) 

Come hear from Denise and our other amazing speakers, gain valuable industry insights, and connect with professionals across the industry.

We hope to see you there!

CSEED is so excited to welcome Joe Alterio into UW! 🎨💻

Joe Alterio is a multidisciplinary creative working at the intersection of art, technology, design, and storytelling. With over 15 years of experience leading design and product teams, he has created digital products and experiences across industries like media, publishing, gaming, and technology.

Throughout his career, Joe has collaborated with major brands including Microsoft, Starbucks, Disney, Nickelodeon, Adobe, and Amazon. His work has received recognition from the Webby, Addy, and Anthem Awards and has been featured in The New York Times, The Atlantic, The Boston Globe, and the BBC.

Joe is also an accomplished speaker, having shared his insights at SXSW, San Diego Comic-Con, and other major events. He co-hosts the design podcast Designer & Designer and is passionate about creativity, collaboration, and building teams where people can do their best work.

Join us for an exciting conversation about creativity, design, technology, and what it means to build things that matter. Don’t miss this opportunity to learn from someone who has spent over 15 years pushing creative boundaries!

events.title: Accessibility Audit - Wallingford
events.description:
UAG welcomes any and all interested students to join us for our Accessibility (Walk) Audit of the Wallingford neighborhood of Seattle. We will be convening in the parking lot of the Burke museum at the start time, then we will travel as a group to the start location.
We will be using an app to record the infrastructure accessibility of a section of the neighborhood. This data can then be used for awareness and advocacy purposes, as well as being integrated into a tool that allows people with mobility impairments plan urban routes that accommodate their specific accessibility needs.
Mostly, these audits are about raising awareness about urban accessibility and enjoying a walk with other great people. Volunteer hours are provided to all participants.
